messages.content: Write the requested Python function. Reply with code only, no explanation, no markdown, no code fences.
Write slugify(title) that lowercases the string, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strips leading and trailing hyphens.

response.text:
def slugify(title):
    import re
    title = title.lower()
    title = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', title)
    title = title.strip('-')
    return title
